## Meeting Purpose

[Align on client pricing strategy and development priorities.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=772.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Ember Pricing:** Propose a €140 user plan + a temporary development fee (e.g., €1k/mo). This simplifies client approval by framing it as a time-limited cost, not a permanent increase.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=867.0)
  - [**Admin Dashboard:** Adrian's PR adds key metrics for Filipe, including guests/service, pending orders, menu schedules, and a list of users who haven't completed their menus.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=453.0)
  - [**"Missed Orders" Report:** Enes will build a new report for admins to bill employees for food ordered but not picked up, a new policy starting next year.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=644.0)
  - [**New Business:** Adrian's network (chef, software sales pro, brother) is generating leads, with a potential upper-management stakeholder (Benedito) already demoing the app.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=271.0)

## Topics

### Ember Pricing Strategy

  - [**Problem:** Ember rejected the initial €7.50/user offer but accepted €5/user, showing they are fair but price-sensitive. A complex pricing model for custom features is likely to be rejected.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=227.0)
  - [**Solution:** Propose a simple, time-limited development fee.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=867.0)
      - [**Base Plan:** €140 user seats.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=179.0)
      - [**Development Fee:** A temporary monthly charge (e.g., €1,000/mo) for the duration of active development.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=888.0)
  - [**Rationale:** This approach is easier for Filipe to get approved, as it's a temporary cost, not a permanent price hike. The fee can be negotiated (e.g., down to €500/mo).](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=981.0)

### Admin Dashboard Enhancements

  - [Adrian's PR adds key metrics for Filipe to the admin dashboard:](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=453.0)
      - [Guests per service](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=453.0)
      - [Pending orders](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=453.0)
      - [Menu schedule status](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=453.0)
      - [List of users who haven't completed their menus](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=499.0)
  - [**Rationale:** Provides Filipe with direct, at-a-glance access to critical operational data.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=535.0)

### "Missed Orders" Report

  - [Enes will build a new report for admins to track food ordered but not picked up.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=644.0)
  - [**Rationale:** Supports Ember's new policy, effective next year, to bill employees for missed meals.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=644.0)
  - [**Implementation:** Build as a reusable component, likely for the admin dashboard, per Filipe's request.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=708.0)

### Business Development

  - [Adrian is leveraging his network to generate leads:](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=343.0)
      - [**Friend (Chef/CQO):** Will begin cold calling from a prepared list.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=343.0)
      - [**Friend (Software Sales):** Actively discussing the app with contacts.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=379.0)
      - [**Brother:** Has received a detailed app summary to share.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=387.0)
  - [**Ember Stakeholder:** A recent demo for Benedito (upper management) is a positive sign, as it could create a satisfied internal champion for the product.](https://fathom.video/share/EvWSPmh724LHmZzaQjVNA9Zyv1Dfjvz4?tab=summary&timestamp=271.0)
